card.name: Tons as a unit of weight
card.fires_on: The weight unit "ton" (tons, tonnes, ton) right after a number or quantity word, often before "of" a material. Also fires on "Ton" inside a name.

modes.label: Ton after a quantity
modes.description: Ton, tons or tonnes follows a number and is followed by "of" plus a material such as CO2, steel or heroin.
modes.example: The bridge is made from 54,000<< tons>> of steel.

modes.label: Ton inside a name or title
modes.description: The letters "Ton" or "ons" appear as the start of a surname or a title.
modes.example: Contact: Barry<< Ton>>ning, Environmental Policy Analyst, The Council

card.plain: It marks the weight unit "ton" after an amount, as in "500 million tons of CO2".
